subject: Bundle Not Found error in deployApp()

messages.author: 9eb2dae3eac30d65
messages.subject: Bundle Not Found error in deployApp()
parts:
Hello,

First, thanks for Shiny and ShinyApps. I'm very excited to try it out for real for my first time!

My app runs locally just fine with runApp(), but I get the same error message every time I try to deploy it:

Error: /v1/applications/26320/deploy 400 - Unable to deploy application-26320. bundle-100460 not found.

The shinyapps folder that is created is empty. I am sure that all of the referenced files are housed inside the current directory. I am sure the working directory is the directory with server.R and ui.R. I also am sure that the app name is not the problem.

Any help would be tremendously appreciated!

Thanks,
Jason
